correctness.rationale: The published 68-facet list reconstructs f=(11,55,150,170,68). Exact mod-two boundary ranks are rank(d2)=45 and rank(d3)=103, so dim H2=2. Exhaustive four-set enumeration finds 58 missing tetrahedra; every boundary raises rank(d3) by one, hence is nonzero. Pairwise quotient comparison gives class sizes 6,24,28. A four-vertex mod-two 2-cycle must be the full tetrahedral boundary, proving minimum support and exhaustiveness.
